_note: MEDICAL-REVIEW: every value in this file. Set reviewed to true only after a specialist signs it off.
emergency_symptoms: Swelling of the face or hands
how_to_measure: Sit quietly for 5 minutes first, with your back supported and feet flat on the floor.
Rest your arm on a table at the level of your heart.
Use a cuff that fits your upper arm, on bare skin.
Do not talk during the reading.
Take two readings a minute apart and write down both.
